Wallet settings.

RPC connection

Public endpoints may rate-limit requests. You can provide a browser-accessible HTTPS RPC URL for the selected network.

Saved on this browser only. Use a URL intended for browser access; do not enter a private API key.

Transfer fees

Wallet fee: 0.3% of the amount, added on top. Receiving and holding assets incur no wallet fee. Network gas and token-account rent are separate.

Creates a separate encrypted wallet locally. Public collection settings must be published by the site owner; EVM collection requires a deployed atomic router.

Wallet custody

The app uses Trust Wallet Core 4.8.4 for BIP39 recovery phrases, Solana address derivation, and local Ed25519 signing. The vault uses AES-256-GCM with PBKDF2-SHA256 (600,000 iterations). It locks after five minutes of inactivity or when the tab is hidden. Solana and seven EVM mainnets are supported. EVM networks share the Ethereum derivation path; ERC20 and BEP20 tokens are added by contract address.

Experimental, unaudited browser software wallet. Test on Devnet. Browser security and access to this site affect key security.
